hook.narration: In this town, nobody claps until morning.

visual.v1: GOLDEN-hour wide: Main Street stage, baker mid-reel on the crate stage, crowd circle with hands in pockets, string lights, hill silhouette beyond rooftops; title card 'NOBODY CLAPS UNTIL MORNING.' over the sky; 4-frame white flash at the hook/s0 boundary

scenes.narration: One night a year, Main Street becomes a stage.

visual.v1: GOLDEN: camera glides along the street (ease-out 20f entry from the hook wide); the crate stage, bunting; continuous follow move

scenes.narration: And every window fills with faces.

visual.v1: GOLDEN: tilt up the facade — windows warm one after another with face after face; bunting sways

scenes.narration: The baker just played the best reel of her life. Silence. She bowed anyway.

visual.v1: GOLDEN: the baker lowers her fiddle and bows to a silent crowd; every visible hand is pocketed; slow push-in creep on her bow; a single string-light sway
GOLDEN: the bow itself — she lowers the fiddle, bends to a silent crowd, hands stay pocketed; slow push-in creep

scenes.narration: 'Not yet,' the mayor said, like I was the strange one.

visual.v1: GOLDEN: mayor close-up, one finger raised; villagers between him and the lens; slight dutch tilt; quoted-line plate 'NOT YET.'

scenes.narration: A kid clapped once, and half the street grabbed his wrists.

visual.v1: GOLDEN: the kid's hands mid-clap, two adults' hands clamp his wrists from both sides; freeze-tension; whip-ease into the tight framing
GOLDEN: the crowd, warm-lit, mid-gesture — but every hand stays flat against a coat; lateral follow

scenes.narration: They cheer. They whistle. They just never clap.

visual.v1: GOLDEN: triptych — open-mouth cheers, two-finger whistles, hands clamped flat; lateral camera follow; faces bright

scenes.narration: This year, the fiddler's last note hung in the air like it was waiting.

visual.v1: NIGHT falling: sky deepens behind the rooftops mid-shot (golden->night crossfade); the fiddler's last note hangs as a glowing quaver above the fiddle; streetlights blink on amber
NIGHT: my hands enter frame bottom and CLAP once — 4-frame white flash at contact + flip-shake kick decaying 7f; the note-shape scatters into sparks

scenes.narration: Once. The sound came back wrong. Too loud.

visual.v1: NIGHT: the clap echoes — the street's windows pulse once, too bright; camera micro-shake; keyframes at u .25/.6/.9

scenes.narration: Like the street itself clapped with me.

visual.v1: NIGHT: the pulse travels down the whole row — every window flashes in sequence as if the street has palms

scenes.narration: Wait. Every window on the street went dark at the same time.

visual.v1: NIGHT-DEEP: the wave reverses — windows snuff out front-to-back in one breath; streetlights dim to embers; the street goes flat dark

VISUAL-ONLY DREAD HOLD (~1.2s): the dead dark street holds; at the hold's end, between the roof gaps, the HILL'S silhouette resolves a head-and-shoulders profile facing the town — subtle, one shape, no glow

scenes.note: L-097 legal pacing cut: held beat, narration empty on purpose

scenes.narration: You see, the hill behind the town listens all year.

visual.v1: NIGHT: tilt-up ease from the street to the HILL wide — the head-and-shoulders silhouette framed clean between two roof gaps; one star directly above it

scenes.narration: Applause isn't praise here. It's payment.

visual.v1: NIGHT: windows relight one by one like coins dropped into a slot — a slow sequence paying up the hill's dark face; each relight ticks a coin of light onto the silhouette's shoulders

scenes.narration: They were never saving their applause for the dancers.

visual.v1: NIGHT: the crowd stands loaded — hands cupped, elbows cocked, the held-applause posture, all facing the hill, not the stage; push-in among their shoulders

scenes.narration: They were saving it for the hill. And now it knows my hands.

visual.v1: NIGHT: my hands in frame bottom — a thin gold seam glows across both palms, pulse-synced; the hill's silhouette leans one degree closer

scenes.narration: This morning, I heard the whole town applaud the sunrise.

visual.v1: DAWN->DAY: the relit payoff — silhouette rows of clapping hands against a brightening sky, night-blue->peach->day-blue crossfade; the sun crests THE HILL; brightest frame of the short (lum target ~0.55)

scenes.narration: It sounded less like joy, and more like rent.

visual.v1: DAY: full day preset — the sun sits above the hill's shoulders, shoulders visibly RELAXED; the town applauds; a banner reads 'FIDDLE NIGHT AGAIN TONIGHT'; deadpan hold on the last word; end
